library.title: Legal Library
library.description: A legal knowledge base that gathers and organizes references, research and legal documents in one place: books, theses, laws, decrees and case law — searchable and downloadable.

admin.exportDesc: This button generates a ZIP archive containing the updated library.json along with the cover and PDF files for every reference added this session.
admin.exportStep1: Unzip the archive, then copy the contents of the books/, covers/ and data/ folders into the project folder (replace data/library.json).
admin.exportStep2: Run the following commands to push the changes to GitHub:
admin.exportStep3: Run the commands below, then push to GitHub.
admin.exportReadme: Copy the data/, books/ and covers/ folders into the project root (replacing data/library.json), then run: git add . && git commit -m "Add new library references" && git push
admin.exportFilesLostWarning: Some files only exist in this session's memory — re-add entries whose files are missing before exporting.
